# qrcode-generator

Local ES modules from [yuriyapostol/qrcode-generator](https://github.com/yuriyapostol/qrcode-generator), version 3.4.0.

Pinned commit: `1edf8ce7c8d9be7d31df3f04dab6fc9d9965ddf8`.

Files copied unchanged from `dist/`: core, UTF-8 encoding, SVG renderer, renderer registry and XML escaping. No remote scripts or build step are required by the extension.
